title: Figma Mirror Manifest
description: Contract for `mirror-manifest.json`, the shared ledger written by the figma-mirror hook (check.py, staleness bookkeeping at Stop) and read/updated by the mirror consumer (mirror_consumer.mjs, the agent-facing use_figma / DesignSync plan builder). HONESTY LAW (gem-hunt N.3, MASTER Theme C): a code->Figma mirror is LOSSY (structure + design tokens survive; React state, routing, data, and logic do NOT). This manifest therefore NEVER represents a sync as authoritative parity. The authoritative staleness signal is a hash comparison, not the cached `status` label: an entry is STALE whenever `content_hash != last_mirrored_hash` (including the never-mirrored case where `last_mirrored_hash` is null). An entry may be labelled `mirrored` ONLY after a real use_figma / DesignSync write was actually performed and recorded (target + a node/path + a timestamp + the exact hash that was mirrored). Nothing in this file may claim a mirror that did not happen.

hash_algo.description: Content-hash algorithm. Fixed to sha256 of the raw file bytes so the Python hook and the Node consumer compute byte-identical hashes.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last manifest write. Advisory only.

target_default.description: Default mirror target for entries that do not name their own. `figma` = the official Figma MCP `use_figma` in-place write (quota-exempt on the Education Full seat). `designsync` = the Figma-free 2nd target: a claude.ai Design System project via the DesignSync tool.

entries.description: Map of normalized source-file path -> mirror entry. Key equals `source`.

source.description: Normalized (absolute, forward-slash) path of the source design/style file this entry mirrors.

content_hash.description: sha256 hex of the current on-disk file bytes, as last observed.

size.description: Size of the source file in bytes, as last observed.

status.description: Cached label. NOT authoritative for staleness (recompute content_hash vs last_mirrored_hash). `stale` = changed since the last real mirror (or never mirrored). `planned` = a mirror plan was emitted but not yet executed. `mirrored` = a real use_figma/DesignSync write was performed and recorded. `unsupported` = the file type cannot be meaningfully mirrored (recorded honestly rather than skipped silently).

target.description: Where this entry is (or will be) mirrored.

figma_node_id.description: The Figma node id updated in place by use_figma, when target=figma and a real write happened.

designsync_path.description: The claude.ai Design System project path written by DesignSync, when target=designsync and a real write happened.

last_mirrored_hash.description: The content_hash that was ACTUALLY mirrored on the last real write. Staleness is defined as content_hash != last_mirrored_hash. Null until a real mirror is recorded.

last_mirrored_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last real mirror write. Null until a real mirror is recorded.

last_seen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the hook last observed this file dirty.

lossy.description: Honesty flag. Always true for a code->Figma mirror: structure + tokens survive the round-trip; state, routing, data, and logic do not. The manifest never pretends a lossy mirror is a faithful sync.

note.description: Free-form honesty caveat: what was intentionally not carried across, or why an entry is unsupported.

allOf.description: A `mirrored` status is only valid once a real write was recorded: a target, a node or path, a timestamp, and the exact mirrored hash must all be present.
